messages:
Maya (Marketing): quick ask — we need eng/runtime to validate a small set of benchmark numbers for next Monday's launch narrative. Not a full audit, but a rerun + sanity checks so marketing can confidently cite p50/p95 latency and a simple cost-per-1k-tokens estimate. Can you take this on? 

Maya (Marketing): target matrix: model=Redwood-13B-chat (and fallback run for 70B quantized if time), seq_lens=[2k,8k], batches=[1,8], regions=[us-west-2, eu-west-1]. Metrics: p50, p95, throughput (tokens/s), and rough token-cost using our quantized profile assumptions. Also include 10 raw request traces for each cell for a quick quality spot-check.

Maya (Marketing): sample payload we want used (replace tokens):
```json
{
  "messages": [{"role":"user","content":"Summarize the document in 3 bullets."}],
  "max_tokens": 512
}
```

Maya (Marketing): deliverables: CSV (one row per cell), short methodology note (one paragraph) we can paste into docs, and a 2–3 line blurb from eng about any caveats. ETA: by end of day Friday if possible. @raj @theresa 

Raj (Eng Runtime): got it. Two quick clarifying q's: 1) for the 70B run do you want int8/qat/llm-int8? 2) when you say 'token-cost' do you want raw GPU time cost estimate or our published per-token billing projection?

Maya (Marketing): thanks — prefer int8 for the 70B run (if available). For cost, please give both if easy: (a) estimated $/1k tokens using our internal cost model, and (b) GPU-minutes breakdown so we can footnote assumptions.

Theresa (Eng Runtime): scheduling note — we can fit the 13B matrix in the regular bench cluster tonight (low traffic window 02:00–05:00 UTC). 70B int8 will be a separate pass and may need a short reserved slot (approx 90m). We'll use existing bench-config v2.3 as baseline (continuous batching enabled, kv-cache warmed).

Raj (Eng Runtime): plan: run baseline config, add a deterministic seed + 10 sample requests per cell for trace artifacts, capture p50/p95 and tokens/s. We'll attach the exact bench config (YAML) and a md note describing batching, concurrency, sequence padding. ETA Friday EOD for CSV + notes. @BenchBot can you queue jobs after approval?

BenchBot: Job queued — bench-suite 'marketing-quick-validate-1805559012' created. Expected runtime 3.6 hours for full 13B matrix. Notifying assigned engs.

Dave (Product Marketing): thanks team — when results land can eng also give a 1–2 sentence conservative blurb like: 'Observed p95 latency Xms on us-west-2 with 8k tokens (13B int8); numbers assume warmed KV cache and batching as described.' We'll use that verbatim if possible.

Raj (Eng Runtime): yep we can produce that exact phrasing and include one-line caveats. Also will flag any noisy failures or tokenization mismatches.

Maya (Marketing): perfect — huge help. If Friday slips, even a partial CSV (just us-west-2 13B) helps our copy. Please ping here when done. :pray:
